content: द्वैध {%a.%} (-धी|{%f.%}) Two-fold, double. .{@-धम्@} .²1 Duality, two-fold nature or state. .²2 Separation into two parts. .²3 Double resource, secondary reserve; कार्यं वीक्ष्य प्रयुञ्जीत द्वैधं संश्रयमेव च <ls>Ms. 7. 161</ls>. .²4 Diversity, difference, conflict, contest, variance; श्रुतिद्वैधं तु यत्र स्यात् तत्र धर्मावुभौ स्मृतौ <ls>Ms. 2. 14</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">9. 32</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 78</ls>. .²5 Doubt, uncertainty; छिन्नद्वैधाः (ऋषयः) <ls>Bg. 5. 25</ls>; <ls>Ve. 6. 44</ls>. .²6 Double-dealing, duplicity, one of the six modes of foreign policy; see द्वैधीभाव below and गुण. .²7 Contradiction. .{@-धम्@} {%ind.%} .²1 In two parts. .²2 In two ways, doubly.
